name: Dioctyltin dineodecanoate
description: Dioctyltin dineodecanoate (CAS 68299-15-0 ) is an organotin compound used as a heat stabilizer and catalyst in polymer processing and coating systems. It functions primarily to prevent thermal degradation during high-temperature manufacturing. This chemical helps in extending the service life of finished materials by protecting the polymer matrix. In PVC compounding, it acts as a heat stabilizer, protecting the polymer from discoloration and chain breakdown. It is highly effective during extrusion and calendering processes where high heat is required. Polyurethane and silicone sealant manufacturers use it as a curing catalyst to control gel time and crosslink density. The compound is suitable for both one- and two-component formulations in various industrial settings. In industrial coatings, it accelerates moisture-cure reactions in isocyanate-based systems for faster through-cure. This acceleration occurs effectively at ambient temperatures, improving production efficiency. Adhesive formulators working with elastomeric systems incorporate it to balance processing speed with open time requirements. Dioctyltin dineodecanoate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid, suitable for direct blending. It is available in technical grade, with supply typically offered in drums or intermediate bulk containers. Specifications are aligned to technical-grade standards relevant to plastics stabilization and catalyst applications.
